title: City Swimming Pool
passage:
City Swimming Pool
Open every day from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m.
On Saturdays and Sundays, from 10 a.m. to 12 p.m., the pool is for families only.
Please bring a towel. You can buy water and snacks at the café next to the pool.
The pool is closed on 1 January.

questions.q: When is the pool open?
questions.explain_ru: В объявлении сказано: Open every day.

questions.q: What do you need to bring?
questions.explain_ru: Please bring a towel — нужно взять полотенце; воду и снеки можно купить.

questions.q: Who can swim on Sunday at 11 a.m.?
questions.explain_ru: По выходным с 10 до 12 бассейн только для семей.

title: A message from Mia
passage:
Hi Sam,
I'm at work until 7 today. Can you buy some bread and milk on your way home? There's money on the kitchen table. Also, my sister is coming for dinner tonight. I'm making pasta. Is that OK with you?
See you later!
Mia

questions.q: Why does Mia write to Sam?
options: To invite him to a party
questions.explain_ru: Мия просит Сэма купить хлеб и молоко.

questions.q: Where is the money?
options: In Mia's bag in the hall
In the fridge next to the milk
On the desk at Mia's work
questions.explain_ru: There's money on the kitchen table.

questions.q: Who is coming tonight?
questions.explain_ru: My sister is coming for dinner tonight.

title: Bike for sale
passage:
Bike for sale
I'm selling my blue bike. It's three years old, but it's in very good condition. It's great for short trips in the city. The price is £80. You can see it at my flat on Park Road. Call or text Ben after 6 p.m.: 07700 900123.

questions.q: How old is the bike?
questions.explain_ru: It's three years old.

questions.q: When can you call Ben?
questions.explain_ru: После 6 вечера — значит, вечером.

questions.q: What is the bike good for?
questions.explain_ru: It's great for short trips in the city.

title: My favourite day
passage: Sunday is my favourite day. I get up at about ten and make pancakes. Then I go for a long walk with my dog by the river. In the afternoon, I call my parents on video because they live in another city. In the evening, I read and go to bed early. On Monday I start work at eight!

questions.q: What does the writer do in the morning?
questions.explain_ru: Утром автор встаёт около десяти и готовит блины.

questions.q: Why does the writer call their parents on video?
options: The parents don't have a phone
questions.explain_ru: Родители живут в другом городе, то есть далеко.

questions.q: Why does the writer go to bed early on Sunday?
options: They are very tired after the long walk
They can't sleep well on Sundays
They start work early the next day
They have a party at work on Monday evening
questions.explain_ru: В понедельник работа начинается в восемь, поэтому автор ложится рано.

title: Green Corner café
passage: I went to Green Corner, a small café near the station, last Saturday. The place is bright and friendly, and there are plants everywhere. I ordered a vegetable soup and a slice of carrot cake. The soup was hot and tasty, but the cake was a bit dry. The prices are good: I paid only £9 for everything. The only problem is that the café is very popular, so it's hard to find a free table at lunchtime. Next time I'll go earlier. I recommend it!

questions.q: What didn't the writer like?
questions.explain_ru: Торт был суховат: the cake was a bit dry.

questions.q: What is the problem with the café?
questions.explain_ru: Кафе очень популярное, в обед трудно найти свободный столик.

questions.q: What does the writer think of Green Corner?
options: It's a good place to visit
questions.explain_ru: Автор рекомендует кафе: I recommend it!

title: A kind stranger
passage: Last month, I was on the train home after a long day at work. I was so tired that I fell asleep. When I woke up, it was my stop, so I jumped up and ran out. On the platform, I suddenly realised that my phone wasn't in my pocket. I felt terrible because all my photos were on it! Then I heard someone calling me. A young woman was running towards me with my phone in her hand. She got off the train just to give it back to me.

questions.q: Why did the writer fall asleep?
options: The train journey was very long
They were bored on the train
questions.explain_ru: После долгого рабочего дня автор очень устал.

questions.q: Why did the writer feel terrible?
options: They thought the phone was lost
questions.explain_ru: Автор понял, что телефона нет в кармане, и подумал, что потерял его.

questions.q: What did the young woman do?
options: She left the train to return the phone
She called the police about the phone
She took the phone to the station office
She phoned the writer's friend to explain
questions.explain_ru: She got off the train just to give it back to me.

title: Ten minutes that change your day
passage: Many of us spend most of the day sitting: at work, in the car or on the sofa. Doctors say that even a short walk can make a big difference. A ten-minute walk after lunch is good for your body and can make you feel less tired in the afternoon. It's also good for your mood. People who walk outside every day often feel calmer and sleep better. You don't need special clothes or a gym. Just put your phone in your pocket, look around and enjoy the fresh air.

questions.q: What is the main idea of the article?
options: Sitting at work all day is dangerous
Doctors want everyone to go to a gym
Phones are bad for your sleep
Short walks are good for body and mind
questions.explain_ru: Статья о том, что даже короткая прогулка полезна для тела и настроения.

questions.q: When does the article suggest a short walk?
questions.explain_ru: A ten-minute walk after lunch.

questions.q: In the text, make a big difference means:
questions.explain_ru: Make a big difference — сильно изменить ситуацию к лучшему.

title: Our phone-free weekend
passage: Last weekend, my family tried something new: two days without phones. At first, my kids weren't happy about it. On Saturday morning, they were bored and kept asking when they could have their phones back. But in the afternoon, we went to the forest, made a fire and cooked sausages. In the evening, we played board games, and everyone laughed a lot. On Sunday, my son said it was the best weekend in a long time! We're not going to stop using our phones, but now we want to have one day without them every month.

questions.q: How did the kids feel on Saturday morning?
questions.explain_ru: Дети скучали и спрашивали, когда им вернут телефоны.

questions.q: What did the family do on Saturday evening?
questions.explain_ru: Вечером семья играла в настольные игры; лес и сосиски были днём.

questions.q: What does the family plan to do now?
options: Have one day without phones every month
Stop using their phones completely at home
Buy new phones for the kids next month
Go to the forest every weekend together
questions.explain_ru: Семья хочет устраивать один день без телефонов каждый месяц.
